The 2022 Formula 1 World Drivers' Championship was won by Max Verstappen of Red Bull Racing.

Some key details:

- This was Max Verstappen's 2nd Formula 1 World Drivers' Championship title.

- He won the 2022 championship with 454 points, clinching the title with 4 races still remaining in the season.

- His main rival for the title was Charles Leclerc of Ferrari, who finished second in the championship with 308 points.

- Red Bull Racing also won the 2022 Formula 1 Constructors' Championship.

So in summary, the 2022 Formula 1 World Drivers' Champion is Max Verstappen of Red Bull Racing.
